Overview

This Privacy Policy explains how AFSV VRC Global Development Group Ltd. (the “Company”) collects, uses, discloses and protects personal information through www.afsvvrc.com, including its contact, interest and pre-registration forms.

How the Company handles personal information

Scope of data collection

The Company collects a broad range of data, including personal information that can reasonably be used to directly or indirectly identify the individual, such as name, mailing address, e-mail, telephone, and IP address, as well as business-related, technical, and non-personal/aggregated information. Collection may occur through direct interactions, user contributions, automated technologies, and third-party sources.

Business contact information carve-out

Business contact information collected, used or disclosed solely to communicate with an individual in relation to their employment, business or profession is exempt from Part 1 of PIPEDA. Other uses fall outside this exemption and are subject to applicable privacy laws.

Use and disclosure

The Company uses personal information to respond to inquiries, provide requested updates, operate and improve the Website and, where applicable, administer events, products and services, including related communications and billing. Commercial electronic messages are sent as permitted by Canada’s Anti-Spam Legislation, and recipients may unsubscribe from marketing messages at any time. The Company may disclose personal information to service providers acting on its behalf, to affiliates for the stated purposes, and to other parties with consent or as otherwise permitted or required by law.

Retention and anonymization

The Company retains personal information only as long as necessary for the purposes for which it was collected or as permitted or required by law. Information that has been anonymized so that it cannot reasonably be linked to an identifiable individual may be used for any legitimate business purpose.

Cross-border transfers

The Company may process, store, and transfer personal information in countries outside Canada where privacy laws may differ, and where local governments, courts, or regulators may access the information. Named destinations include the United States, the European Union, and other jurisdictions where service providers and affiliates operate.

Individual rights

Individuals may request access to or correction of their personal information and may withdraw consent, subject to applicable legal or contractual restrictions. The Company responds to access requests within 30 days, subject to extensions permitted by law.

Children and youth

This Website provides information about proposed programs for children and youth. Website inquiry forms are intended for adults. Parents or legal guardians may inquire about a child using their own contact details. Please do not include the child's full name, diagnoses, medical records or other sensitive personal information in website forms. We do not solicit personal information directly from children under 16.

Security

The Company disclaims responsibility for unauthorized third-party circumvention of privacy/security measures, provided it has implemented and maintained reasonable safeguards, and notes transmission of information is at the user’s own risk.

Privacy inquiries & access requests

Privacy inquiries, access requests and complaints may be directed by email to the attention of Privacy Officer, AFSV VRC Global Development Group Ltd., at info@afsvvrc.com. If your concern remains unresolved, you may contact the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada.
